recommendation: Keep the audit commit as the core reconciliation record. Future Permission search-parameter work should be made in HL7/data-access-policies unless core reintroduces Permission as an active resource.
issue_request: FHIR-50220 is an Applied/Persuasive Security WG R6 change request asking to add a Permission search parameter for Permission.rule.data.period so servers can find Permission resources whose validity period opens or closes on a relevant date. The approved resolution was to add a SearchParameter targeting Permission.rule.data.period.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied while Permission was still an active core resource. HL7/fhir PR #3522 merged on 2025-07-03; commit e35c6b3ba4e1b2de2e6d30e17f3fe78feb4e706a added Permission-rule-data-period to source/permission/bundle-Permission-search-params.xml with expression Permission.rule.data.period, and commit 0c4d08d0b8f884a863c3a48bc993439535f1ca32 corrected the SearchParameter code to rule-data-period.
additional_context: Permission is no longer in the current core build. Commit 0e2a8a7f839d5e1a43787523daccf07d958362f3 removed source/permission and the active fhir.ini Permission entries, and current core narrative links Permission to the HL7 Data Access Policies IG. The current HL7/data-access-policies source already includes Permission-rule-data-period with code rule-data-period, type date, and expression Permission.rule.data.period. FHIR-50221 and FHIR-50222, companion Permission search-parameter issues from the same PR, are already represented on the combined branch as external-repo audit commits.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit and made no core source change because the requested Permission validity search parameter belongs to the external Data Access Policies source of truth rather than the current FHIR core build.
